In `OptimizedImage.optimize`, animated dispatch is gated by `from =~ /\.GIF$/i`, which checks the *path string* extension: `method_name += "_animated" if !!opts[:allow_animation] && from =~ /\.GIF$/i`. A tempfile path typically won’t end with `.gif`, so `_animated` instructions will not be selected for GIF uploads in this code path, matching
records.stripped_text: Animated-GIF branch in optimized_image.rb is keyed on '.GIF' filename extension, but controller passes tempfile.path with no extension, so animated GIFs are silently flattened to a single frame and allow_animation is dead code
